# Projects

## Climate & Trade

::: {.key-finding}
[CBAM & Saudi Carbon Pricing](cbam-project.qmd){style="text-decoration:none;color:#1a3c40;font-weight:600;"}

A three-layer economic model analyzing how EU carbon border fees interact with domestic carbon pricing for Saudi Arabia. Built with Python, calibrated from KAPSARC's KGEMM. Found that CBAM savings reduce the net cost of carbon pricing by 3 to 7 percent, worth up to $308 million per year.
:::
